commentary_summary: The Panamax market held a firmer feel overall this week with tonne-mile demand rose slightly 1.4% in week 47 to reach 109.3. In tandem, Benchamark baltic rates also followed this upward trajectory. | The USDA reported over 1.5 million tonnes of soybean sales to China last week, marking the first major purchase of the current marketing year, with shipments scheduled for two vessels, including a Kamsarmax. | Ballast congestion in the Atlantic is expected to edge higher in the coming weeks, supported by China stepping up US soybean buying and renewed demand from US Gulf grain and US East Coast coal trades.
